inputs.checklistItemText: Buildings and permanent structures do not maintain minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors
inputs.question: Show the spatial relationship between the proposed buildings (1-8), the overhead electric lines and poles, and identify which buildings, if any, are located near the overhead electric infrastructure. Indicate the general location of the overhead lines relative to each building.
inputs.regionHint: throughout the site, particularly near the southern and western portions where overhead lines were shown on the existing conditions survey

output.reasoning: The agent is asking for identification and spatial relationship description (presence, location, proximity assessment) rather than a specific clearance measurement; this is a progressive verification step to identify which buildings are near OHE before measuring actual clearance distances.
